subtype_label: Focus internal / focus inference (no given focus)
query: Help me understand what's worth analyzing in these incident tickets.

judge.implied_focus: The nature/anatomy of incidents captured in ticket free-text: what device/component fails, what problem occurs, and how it gets resolved.

per_column.name: incident_category
per_column.rationale: Classifies the incident into a semantic category derived from short_description, anchoring the 'what kind of incident' facet.

per_column.name: device_component
per_column.rationale: Identifies the affected hardware/component, a concrete facet of the incident subject.

per_column.name: problem_type
per_column.rationale: Characterizes the failure mode (malfunction, connectivity, update issue), a distinct and complementary facet.

per_column.name: resolution_action
per_column.rationale: Captures how the incident was addressed, closing the problem->resolution loop and adding analytical value.

per_column.name: recurring_pattern
per_column.rationale: Flags whether the incident reflects a repeated issue; relevant to prioritizing what's worth analyzing, though slightly broader.

per_column.name: urgency_signal
per_column.rationale: A bare urgency boolean overlaps with the existing priority column and drifts toward generic severity tagging rather than the incident-anatomy focus.

judge.rationale: The added columns collectively centre on a coherent, data-inferable focus: decomposing the incident's substance from free-text into component / problem / resolution facets. This is far from a grab-bag or mechanical text-length noise; four columns (category, component, problem_type, resolution_action) form a well-differentiated predictor/attribute set at a useful granularity, enabling analysis like 'which components drive which problems and resolutions.' recurring_pattern adds a legitimate prioritization angle. urgency_signal is the weakest link: a bare boolean that largely duplicates the existing priority field and slightly dilutes the focus. Overall the implied focus is clearly actionable (an analyst can pivot on component/problem/resolution and target recurring hot spots), so scores are high but not maximal due to the mild redundancy/drift of urgency_signal.
